description: A public website showcasing the two dog breeds represented in the existing repository, with a secure admin area for managing breeds, dogs, and customer inquiries.

questions.question: Which language should the public website and admin portal use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is a strong default for a maintainable web frontend.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for a maintainable frontend.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Standard JavaScript without static typing.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should the website and admin portal use?
questions.rationale: React with TypeScript is a broadly supported choice for a public site and interactive admin portal.

options.label: React
options.description: A widely used component-based framework.

options.label: Vue
options.description: A progressive framework with a gentle learning curve.

options.label: Angular
options.description: A full-featured framework with an integrated application structure.

options.label: Svelte
options.description: A compiler-based framework with a lightweight runtime.

questions.question: Which language should the website API use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript can share language familiarity with the frontend while supporting a standard API stack.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for a Node.js API.

options.label: C# (.NET)
options.description: A strongly typed, production-ready API platform.

options.label: Python
options.description: A readable language with a broad web ecosystem.

options.label: Java
options.description: A mature language and ecosystem for APIs.

questions.question: Which backend framework should the API use?
questions.rationale: NestJS provides a structured TypeScript API framework; the chosen language may lead to a different framework.

options.label: NestJS
options.description: A structured Node.js framework for TypeScript APIs.

options.label: Express
options.description: A lightweight and flexible Node.js framework.

options.label: ASP.NET Core
options.description: A high-performance framework for C# APIs.

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: A modern API framework for Python.

options.label: Spring Boot
options.description: A comprehensive framework for Java APIs.

questions.question: Which data stores should the application use?
questions.rationale: PostgreSQL is requested for application data. Blob Storage is needed for uploaded and displayed dog/breed photos; keep provider credentials in server-side environment configuration.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational storage for breeds, dogs, and inquiries.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for uploaded and publicly served pet images.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only when the application needs no persistence or file/object storage.

questions.question: Should users sign in to access application API features?
questions.rationale: The admin panel must be restricted to authenticated administrators; public visitors can browse and submit inquiries without signing in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require administrator sign-in for protected management features.

options.label: No
options.description: Do not require sign-in for application API features.
